q1_issues.issue: '10-year' is silently dropped from the NP: 'the benchmark 10-year note' is typed only benchmark_note, so a stated restriction on the referent's kind is lost.
A scalar-change subject takes Theme, not Agent - 'lose' is a listed change-of-value verb and its figure is a delta, not a direct object.
The stated delta 'lost 11/32 in price' is dropped entirely - no MeasureBy on the lose event - losing both the magnitude and the clause-stated dimension noun 'price'.
The end value is asserted as the note's own timeless Measure, which the Scalar change section explicitly bars; a stated change's endpoint takes (MeasureTo <event> ...).
The start value is asserted as the bearer's own past standing Measure instead of (MeasureFrom <event> ...) on the change eventuality.
The participial adjunct 'taking its yield ...' is never reified as an eventuality, and its time adjunct 'late on Monday' is dropped with no atom anywhere.

q2_gaps: a fractional bond-price magnitude ('11/32') in a Measure/MeasureBy magnitude slot - magnitudes are native numbers and (Fraction n d) is licensed only as a ProportionOf level
a time adjunct scoping over only the from-value of a scalar change ('from 3.17 percent late on Monday') - MeasureFrom has no time slot and attaching Monday to the lose event would misdate it
notes: Name, genus atom and past tense on the lose event are right; the modifier '10-year', the 11/32 delta with its stated 'price' dimension, the taking eventuality and the Monday adjunct are all absent, and both yield figures are flattened into standing measures on the note.
